spec.title: Memory in Use
spec.description: Memory in use by Host OS, VM's and Containers

spec.query:
from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "cpustat" and
    r._field == "wait"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn:mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "avail" or r._field == "used")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["nodename"] == "${server}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with 
    _time: r._time,
    _measurement: r.measurement,
    _field: "used_perc",
    _value: float(v: 100) / (float(v: r.avail) + float(v: r.used)) * float(v:r.used)
     }))
  |> drop(columns: ["avail","used"])

// 1. Ambil metrik angka (snapshot terakhir)
numeric_data = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system" or r["_measurement"] == "cpustat")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["object"] == "qemu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["nodename"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "cpus" or r["_field"] == "cpu" or r["_field"] == "uptime" or r["_field"] == "maxmem" or r["_field"] == "mem" or r["_field"] == "maxdisk")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: float(v: r._value) }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

// 2. Ambil metrik teks (Status & Name)
text_data = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["object"] == "qemu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["nodename"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "status" or r["_field"] == "name")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: string(v: r._value) }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

// 3. Hitung Rata-rata (MEAN) IO Read & Write (MB/s)
io_data = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "diskread" or r["_field"] == "diskwrite")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["object"] == "qemu")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["nodename"] =~ /${server:regex}/)
  |> group(columns: ["host", "nodename", "_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1048576.0 }))  // bytes/s -> MB/s
  |> mean() // <-- Menggunakan mean() untuk mendapatkan rata-rata
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "nodename"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

// 4. Gabungkan semua data
join1 = join(tables: {num: numeric_data, txt: text_data}, on: ["host", "nodename"])
final = join(tables: {j: join1, io: io_data}, on: ["host", "nodename"])

// 5. Output ke tabel
final
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      ID: r.host,
      "VM Name": if exists r.name and r.name != "" then r.name else r.host,
      Status: if exists r.status then r.status else "unknown",
      Node: r.nodename,
      Type: "qemu",
      CPU: if exists r.cpus then int(v: r.cpus) else 0,
      RAM: if exists r.maxmem then r.maxmem else 0.0,
      Disk: if exists r.maxdisk then r.maxdisk else 0.0,
      Uptime: if exists r.uptime then int(v: r.uptime) else 0,
      "CPU usage": if exists r.cpu then r.cpu else 0.0,
      "RAM usage": if exists r.mem and exists r.maxmem and r.maxmem > 0.0 
                   then (r.mem / r.maxmem) * 100.0 
                   else 0.0,
      "IO Read (MB/s)": if exists r.diskread then r.diskread else 0.0,
      "IO Write (MB/s)": if exists r.diskwrite then r.diskwrite else 0.0
    }))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["ID", "VM Name", "CPU usage", "RAM usage", "IO Read (MB/s)", "IO Write (MB/s)", "Node", "Status"])
